messages:
Evelyn: Heads-up team  We're launching a small pricing page experiment tomorrow: 'Clarity estimator' (mini-estimator + FAQ microtips). Goal: simpler flow, higher demo CTR and better-qualified demo leads.
Sam: Nice. Primary metric?
Evelyn: Demo CTA clicks per pageview. Baseline = 3.4%. Target +1.0pp. Secondary: demo form completion and lead quality.
Diego: Copy variants? Any legal flags?
Evelyn: Two variants: Variant A = examples-led (3 quick workload examples & estimate). Variant B = form-led (tokens/day + model family input). FAQ becomes microtips. Legal approved wording "ephemeral by default" and asked for a link to full privacy page.
Maya: Routing: add query param `exp=clarity_est_v1`. Tag leads who open the prefiller with `lead_tag=clarity_est_v1`. If prefiller estimate >$4k/mo -> route to AE-mid, otherwise AE-sdr.
OpsBot: preview build: https://preview.redwood.dev/pricing?exp=clarity_est_v1 (build 1985).
Sam: Tracking events: `clarity_est_used`, `prefill_applied`, `faq_tip_open`. Add UTM `claritycalc_v1`.
Diego: Accessibility: announce estimates via ARIA live region; tooltips must be keyboard-focusable. Fire event `aria_announce_estimate` when estimate loads.
Evelyn: Rollout plan: 7 days at 12% traffic, 50/50 variants. Check on day 3 for early signal; if strong, shift to 25/75.
Maya: Webinar tie-in idea: users estimating >$2k see a subtle CTA "Join cost clinic" which opens a 15-min sign-up modal. Track `webinar_reg_from_est`.
Sam: Benchmark narrative: need 2 slides—cost vs latency for chat/summarize and example monthly projections for 3 personas. Diego can you assemble numbers?
Diego: Yep, pulling from /assets/benchmarks/cost_latency_v3.csv. Will draft slides by Tue.
Evelyn: Guardrails: if demo CTR rises but MQL quality drops, we'll keep the estimator but remove automatic prefill. If support tickets referencing calculator spike >5/day, roll back.
Maya: Dev ask: include `experiment` in data layer and pass `variant` (A or B) with each event. Also capture time-on-calculator.
OpsBot: Analytics hooks verified in preview.
Sam: Final checklist: design approved, legal ok, dev hooks added. Flip 12% tomorrow 9:15am PT if no blockers. I'll monitor daily and post results here. :rocket:
